sections.title: Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences (Eli Lilly)
sections.description: Eli Lilly (Indianapolis HQ) — one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies, with blockbuster GLP-1 agonist drugs creating unprecedented commercial demand.

blocks.heading: GLP-1 and obesity drug analytics
paragraphs: ML for Lilly's extraordinary GLP-1 commercial analytics challenge — the unprecedented demand for tirzepatide (Mounjaro for diabetes, Zepbound for obesity) has created supply chain, patient access, and market analytics requirements unlike any drug launch in pharmaceutical history.

blocks.heading: Drug discovery ML
paragraphs: Machine learning for Eli Lilly's pharmaceutical R&D programs — molecular property prediction, clinical biomarker discovery, and the computational biology applications supporting Lilly's pipeline beyond GLP-1 (Alzheimer's disease, cancer, immunology).

blocks.heading: Clinical trial analytics
paragraphs: ML for Lilly's large global clinical research program — patient recruitment prediction, protocol deviation monitoring, and trial performance analytics for the clinical trials supporting Lilly's $5B+ annual R&D investment.

sections.title: Healthcare (IU Health)
sections.description: Indiana University Health (Indianapolis HQ) — Indiana's largest healthcare system with 15+ hospitals and strong academic medical center programs.

blocks.heading: Clinical prediction and population health
paragraphs: ML for IU Health's large Indiana patient population — sepsis, readmission, and clinical deterioration prediction integrated with IU Health's Epic clinical system.

blocks.heading: Indiana Medicaid (IHCP) analytics
paragraphs: Population health ML for the managed care organizations serving Indiana's Healthy Indiana Plan and traditional Medicaid programs.

blocks.heading: Academic research AI
paragraphs: ML for IU School of Medicine's research programs — a major academic partner of IU Health.

sections.title: Manufacturing (Cummins)
sections.description: Cummins (Columbus IN HQ, 40 miles south of Indianapolis) — the world's largest independent diesel engine manufacturer with $24B+ annual revenue.

blocks.heading: Engine manufacturing quality ML
paragraphs: Process control and defect prediction ML for Cummins's large engine manufacturing operations across Indiana — predictive maintenance for the precision manufacturing equipment and yield analytics for the complex engine assembly processes.

blocks.heading: Alternative power analytics
paragraphs: ML for Cummins's growing alternative power products — hydrogen fuel cells, electric powertrains, and natural gas engines that are increasingly important to Cummins's technology portfolio.

blocks.heading: Life and long-term care insurance analytics

blocks.heading: Senior market insurance analytics

sections.title: Indianapolis's emergence as a healthcare technology powerhouse
sections.description: Indianapolis's concentration of major healthcare companies has created a healthcare technology depth that is among the highest in the US.

blocks.heading: Eli Lilly's AI transformation
paragraphs: Eli Lilly has made AI a central pillar of its drug discovery and commercial strategy — the company's investment in computational biology, ML-accelerated drug discovery, and commercial analytics (particularly around GLP-1 demand forecasting and patient access analytics) has made Lilly one of the most AI-sophisticated pharmaceutical companies in the world. Lilly's Indianapolis AI investment has created a large healthcare AI talent community in central Indiana.

blocks.heading: The Salesforce Indianapolis effect
paragraphs: Salesforce's large Indianapolis presence — including naming rights to Salesforce Tower, one of Indianapolis's most prominent office buildings — has added enterprise SaaS AI culture to Indianapolis's predominantly healthcare and manufacturing technology base. The interaction between Salesforce's CRM AI capabilities and Indianapolis's healthcare and financial services clients creates interesting applied AI at the intersection of commercial technology and regulated industries.

blocks.heading: Indiana's life sciences cluster
paragraphs: Indianapolis has a growing life sciences cluster beyond Eli Lilly — including Elanco Animal Health (Greenfield IN, adjacent Indianapolis, one of the world's largest animal health companies), Corteva Agriscience, and a growing biotech startup community that the Indiana Biosciences Research Institute is cultivating. This broader life sciences cluster creates AI demand that extends Lilly's anchor effect across the life sciences industry.
